name: Bathkeeper Una
title: The Bath House
examine: Steam-pink and cheerfully tyrannical. Inside her door rank means nothing, ore-dust means a second scrub, and the Crown itself would be handed a brush and told to do its neck.
lines: Ore washes off. The shift takes longer. Sit in the steam till your shoulders drop, that's the actual price of admission.
The spring is the mountain being kind. It is not otherwise a kind mountain. Say thank you.
The mine pays for the miners. Everyone else pays for the miners too, they just get a bath out of it.
